title: Koi aur ho to lao
body:
dil o jaan e meer e kausar koi aur ho to lao
ke hussain ibne hyder koi aur ho to lao
<<DIVIDER>>
raahe haq mein banda parwar koi aur ho to lao
jo luta sake bhara ghar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sadayein aa rahi hai mujhe dashte karbala se
ke misaale hurr muqaddar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sunaye zikre kausar wo bahot milenge lekin
jo pilaye jaam e kausar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kabhi na bujh sakenge jo abad talak jalenge
wo charaagh hai bahattar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi deen e mustafa ko kabhi mustafa ki azmat
jo bachaye jaan de kar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai urooj chod to doon ye rasool ka gharana
par shafi e roz e mehshar koi aur ho to lao
dil o jaan e meer e kausar...
author: Urooj Bijnori
